instruction: Could you move the text box to the bottom of the image? I want it positioned near the bottom edge.

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the 'Thanks World' text box to the bottom of the image. The evaluator exports the image as bottomside_textbox.png and checks if the bottommost dark pixel is within the bottom 5% of the image height. This maintains similar complexity to the original task but with vertical positioning at the bottom.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies text box position at bottom of image using connected component analysis
Metric function properly identifies text box region using ndimage.label to find largest connected component
Robust noise filtering: requires minimum 100 pixels to avoid false positives from artifacts
Dual verification: checks both bottommost edge (95% threshold) AND centroid (80% threshold) for reliability
Proper error handling with try-except and edge case checks (no dark pixels, no components, empty coords)
Postconfig correctly exports image via Shift+Ctrl+E with proper naming and save sequence
Getter correctly fetches exported PNG file from VM using get_vm_file
All instruction requirements covered: verifies text box is 'positioned near the bottom edge'
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider making the 100-pixel threshold configurable for different font sizes
Minor: Could add logging to help debug cases where verification fails
